{{Quote|What about his honor guard? Would they be from his family?"''<br />''"All honor guards wear military black. Huh. I wonder what he's done with the rest of his entourage.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Chak Fel]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
The '''honor guard''' were [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]] who served as [[Bodyguard/Legends|guard]]s for [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] diplomats.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> Although family guards wore their respective [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] colors,<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> the honor guards wore the [[Defense Fleet uniform|uniforms]] in military [[Color/Legends|black]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
